title: Vendor Terms
html:
FOOD TRUCK CENTRE (FTC)

FTC Vendor Booking Terms

  1. Booking Acceptance
  • Vendors are not obligated to accept booking requests originating from the Booking platform foodtruckcentre.com.au
  • Once a quote from the Vendor to the Organiser is accepted by the Organiser, a booking becomes a binding agreement between Vendor and Organiser

  1. Service Delivery

Vendors must:

  • Arrive on time and fully prepared
  • Deliver services as described in their listing and agreed terms
  • Comply with all food safety and operational requirements

  1. Pricing and Transparency
  • Vendors must provide clear and accurate pricing
  • Any additional fees must be disclosed upfront
  • Hidden charges are not permitted

  1. Deposits and Payments
  • Vendors may require a deposit to secure bookings
  • Final payment terms must be clearly stated
  • Vendors are responsible for collecting payments unless otherwise arranged

  1. Cancellations
  • Vendors must clearly state cancellation policies
  • Any cancellation fees must be reasonable and disclosed in advance

  1. Insurance and Compliance

Vendors must maintain:

  • Public liability insurance (recommended minimum $20 million)
  • All required licences and permits

Proof may be requested by FTC at any time.

  1. Conduct and Reputation

Vendors must:

  • Act professionally at all times
  • Avoid behaviour that may damage FTC’s reputation
  • Refrain from misleading or deceptive conduct

  1. Platform Fees
  • Vendors agree to pay all applicable FTC commissions which currently (from April 2026 on until changed at the discretion of FTC and advised to the Vendor beforehand) is 10% of the successful gross booking fee collected by the Vendor.
  • Attempts to avoid fees (including off-platform dealings) are strictly prohibited

  1. Disputes
  • Vendors must attempt to resolve disputes directly with Organisers
  • FTC may assist but is not responsible for outcomes

  1. Termination

FTC may suspend or remove Vendors who:

  • Breach these terms
  • Fail to meet service standards
  • Attempt to bypass the Platform

For correspondence about these Vendor Booking Terms contact info@foodtruckcentre.com.au
